findings.evidence: GitPackSource validates deskpet-pack.json before returning; raw SKILL.md repositories cannot cross it.
findings.root_cause: Raw Git transport and canonical pack validation need separate contracts.

findings.evidence: StagedPack retains requested ref while GitPackSource discards stdout and deletes .git.
findings.root_cause: Transport result lacks host-issued immutable resolved-source evidence.

findings.evidence: Git source enforces only timeout; byte/file limits run after clone and checkout.
findings.root_cause: Post-materialization package limits do not bound Git transport.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: Primary did not trace size checks relative to object download.

findings.evidence: Filesystem traversal after checkout cannot reliably identify gitlink mode after .git deletion.
findings.root_cause: Exact Git tree modes must be inspected before materialization.
findings.why_not_found_in_round_one: Primary grouped symlink/submodule rejection as filesystem validation.

conclusion.summary: Split bounded RawGitSkillSource from canonicalizer; spike filtered fetch/tree streaming bounds or choose bounded GitHub archive transport.
